faq.caption: (FAQ)
faq.heading: Your Questions, Answered
faq.q1: What types of homes are available?
faq.a1: Elyse offers a selection of refined living spaces, including garden suites, duplex residences, and a signature penthouse. Each home is thoughtfully designed to balance elegance, comfort, and a deep connection to the surrounding landscape.
faq.a2: Elyse combines timeless architectural design, a wellness-focused lifestyle, and a serene coastal-mountain setting. Every space is thoughtfully crafted to inspire calm, elevate daily living, and create a sense of refined harmony.
faq.q3: What wellness amenities are available to residents?
faq.a3: Residents enjoy access to a private fitness studio, a spa and wellness center, a meditation lounge, rooftop gardens, walking paths, and landscaped courtyards — all created to support balance, vitality, and thoughtful living.
faq.q4: How private and secure is the community?
faq.a4: Elyse Residence is designed as an intimate, low-density environment with a strong focus on privacy. The community offers controlled access, discreet internal pathways, and homes positioned to ensure tranquility and personal space.
